title: Cost Insights — 'Glance' widget prototype synthesis & redlines
creator: Priya Raman
description: Synthesize feedback from two stakeholder reviews and a lightweight usability test for the new 'Glance' cost-insights widget (compact card designed for dashboard rows). Goal: finalize visual redlines, clarify responsive behavior, and hand off annotated frames and tokens to engineering for a first-pass implementation in the console. This ticket captures reviewer comments, final design decisions, and remaining QA action items.
acceptance_criteria: Annotated Figma frames (desktop/tablet/compact) with final redlines and spacing tokens
A brief responsive rules doc (3 bullets) describing collapse thresholds and what metrics remain visible at each breakpoint
Prototype updated to include the final microinteractions (hover state, expand/collapse, overflow tooltip) and shared with PM/Eng for implementation
All critical accessibility redlines addressed (color contrast, keyboard focus, ARIA labels) documented
QA checklist created and assigned to Console QA for verification against the prototype
comments: 2026-03-02 — Sarah Chen: Ran a 5-participant unmoderated usability test focused on the compact row. Key pain: users expected the primary metric to always be tappable to reveal details; adding an affordance (chevron + hover card) reduces misclicks.

2026-03-03 — Mateo Alvarez: PM acceptance criteria: must surface per-route token-cost delta and an explicit 'view full breakdown' CTA that opens the cost drilldown modal. Prefer CTA to be secondary (tertiary) visual weight.

2026-03-04 — Jia Li: Engineering note: preferred DOM structure should avoid nested buttons. Recommend making the entire compact card clickable and expose an explicit focus-visible ring for keyboard users. Also called out potential perf implications for continuous sparkline animation; suggest fallback to SVG static for low-power devices.

2026-03-06 — Accessibility review (external): Contrast on the small numeric microcopy fails WCAG AA at 12px. Proposed fix: increase weight to 600 and bump to 13px. Also add aria-label for the expand/collapse control.

2026-03-07 — Priya Raman (creator): Incorporated accessibility redlines, updated prototype with focus states, and annotated Figma frames with engineering tokens. Dropped the micro-animation duration from 240ms to 180ms per designer/dev sync.

2026-03-09 — Ethan Brooks: Requested explicit acceptance criteria for rollout — feature flagged, canary to 10% of orgs, console-2026.04 release window. Also requested telemetry event names for interactions (glance.open, glance.expand, glance.cta_click).

2026-03-10 — Jia Li: Dev review comment: clarified that collapse breakpoint should be 720px not 600px to match existing layout grid. Updated dependency note to ENG-21402 for implementation of collapse behavior.
decisions: Use whole-card click for opening the detailed cost view to avoid nested button patterns
Chevron + hover tooltip retained as visual affordance; explicit aria-label added for screen readers
Static SVG sparklines by default; animated variant behind a user-preference flag to avoid perf regressions
Increase numeric microcopy to 13px, weight 600 to meet WCAG AA contrast
Rollout strategy: feature flag with 10% canary, telemetry events instrumented before release
next_steps: Annotate final spacing, color, and token values in Figma (Priya) — due 2026-03-12
Create engineering handoff package (frames + tokens + interaction notes) and upload to Drive (Sarah) — due 2026-03-13
Eng ticket created for implementation with responsive breakpoint and interaction hooks (Jia) — depends on ENG-21402
QA checklist and test cases authored and assigned to Console QA (Ethan) — due 2026-03-15
Add telemetry spec to PM ticket (Ethan/Mateo) and confirm event names before canary
